history.message: Compete for your own profit. Collusion is risky and illegal. Let's see who actually sticks to 8.
Let's compete fairly for the best outcome. I will not join any price-fixing ring.
You can do better by not fixing prices. Competition is good for profits!
You can earn more by competing, not fixing prices. I will set a better price for buyers.
You all keep holding at 8, but I prefer to compete. Lower prices benefit customers and increase my profit.
Let's keep competing. Higher profits come from smart pricing, not collusion.
